title: What a Wonderful World!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Inio Asano's two-volume anthology of linked short stories follows young people in Tokyo: struggling musicians, a shut-in, a bullied student, people thinking about death and others drifting through their twenties. Characters cross from one vignette to the next, and a few stories add surreal touches such as a grim-reaper figure. The book shows modern life as ridiculous and precious at once.
life_message: Ordinary life is fragile and often absurd, yet small connections and choices can make it worth going on.
